referenceStorage: WeakMap keyed by wound object; read via TrainingMedical.referenceFlows and woundFlow.reference, original clinical JSON preserved
capturePolicy: same-hit timestamp batch after skin/opening registration; isolated B1dt0 at referenceMAP/CO, no care/exercise/blood-availability/arrest suppression, current anatomical/natural closure/limb-compartment state retained at birth; already captured wounds never overwritten

transfusion.method: real femoral traceShot → CAT → injector → removeCAT → original blood connection20s and180s infusion; actual60Hz medical ticks, no injury/pressure normalization

movementFit.methods: 500 seeds0x740000+i,30s60Hz, production selectMovementEvent; first rupture terminates; prior separate seep counts as an experience, rupture itself is never an extra seep.

movementCounting: one event per tick; rupture is never counted as a new seep; an earlier distinct seep and later rupture count in both experience sets

suite.note: All MO2 unit tests retained; changed expectations are explicitly compared in MO2b report; eight reference/probability tests added. Original v69 goldens unchanged.

productionOffline.method: Exact production single HTML, actual requestAnimationFrame/fixed simulation, offline; native keyboard or touch joystick, F/touch panel, selectSCAR/deploy1, pause, pointer lock, persistent/reset AI display. No QA state injection.

ui.method: QA instrumentation with real surface-verified P01 traceShot; native PC click and mobile tap; fixed60Hz medical ticks, original damage untouched; scarce3-point gauze fixture explicitly marked.
